title: Amazing academic experience
content: Stanford has been incredible for my CS education. The professors are world-class and the opportunities for research and internships are endless. The campus is beautiful and the weather is perfect year-round.

title: Great but challenging
content: The psychology program is excellent and the research opportunities are amazing. However, the workload can be overwhelming at times. The student community is very supportive though.

title: Harvard Business School exceeded expectations
content: The Harvard brand opens so many doors. The networking opportunities are incredible and the education is top-notch. The case study method really prepares you for real-world business challenges.

title: Perfect for environmental studies
content: Berkeley is the perfect place to study environmental science. The faculty is passionate and the location in the Bay Area provides amazing opportunities for internships and research.

title: MIT engineering is unmatched
content: The engineering program at MIT is absolutely incredible. The hands-on projects and research opportunities are amazing. The professors are brilliant and very accessible.

title: Great medical school experience
content: The University of Michigan Medical School is excellent. The clinical rotations are diverse and the faculty is very supportive. Ann Arbor is a great college town.

title: NYU Tisch is amazing for film
content: NYU Tisch School of the Arts is incredible for film students. The location in NYC provides amazing opportunities and the faculty has real industry experience.

title: UT Austin CS program is solid
content: The computer science program at UT Austin is very good. Austin is a great tech hub and there are plenty of internship opportunities. The campus is beautiful.

title: Decent engineering program
content: The engineering program is decent but could be better. The facilities are good and the professors are knowledgeable, but class sizes are very large.

title: Great CS program in Seattle
content: UW's computer science program is excellent, especially with Seattle being a major tech hub. The opportunities for internships at companies like Microsoft and Amazon are amazing.

title: Solid business program
content: UNC's business program is very good. The Kenan-Flagler Business School has a great reputation and the career placement is excellent. Chapel Hill is a beautiful college town.

title: Harvard Law is incredible
content: Harvard Law School is everything I expected and more. The professors are brilliant, the opportunities are endless, and the network you build is invaluable.
